title: Disabling and re-enabling of UE's E-UTRA capability

entities.name: Disable E-UTRA capability
entities.description: Procedure where the UE disables its E-UTRA capability, typically when in EMM-IDLE mode, to prevent unwanted handover or cell reselection to E-UTRAN or due to specific reject causes.

entities.name: Re-enable E-UTRA capability
entities.description: Procedure where the UE re-enables its E-UTRA capability, typically during PLMN selection or under specific conditions like power cycle, mode change, or timer expiry.

entities.name: EMM-IDLE
entities.description: EPS Mobility Management idle state; the UE shall only disable E-UTRA capability when in this state.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE
entities.description: A substate of EMM-REGISTERED indicating limited service availability; entered when disabling E-UTRA capability due to redirection to 5GCN and no suitable cell found.

entities.name: Redirection to 5GCN required
entities.description: Condition triggered by receiving reject cause #31, leading to specific procedures for disabling E-UTRA capability and searching for 5GCN-connected cells.

entities.name: EMM cause #15 with Extended EMM cause IE
entities.description: Condition where UE receives ATTACH REJECT or TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT with EMM cause #15 and Extended EMM cause IE value 'E-UTRAN not allowed', leading to E-UTRA capability disabling if configured.

entities.name: Extended EMM cause IE
entities.description: Information Element carrying extended cause values, such as 'E-UTRAN not allowed', used in reject messages to trigger E-UTRA capability disabling.

entities.name: Disable E-UTRA capability
entities.description: Property where the UE disables E-UTRA capability, affecting RAT selection and NAS signaling, e.g., by not setting E-UTRA support bits in relevant IEs.

entities.name: Implementation-specific timer
entities.description: A timer started by the UE when disabling E-UTRA capability due to redirection to 5GCN; on expiry, the UE may re-enable E-UTRA capability and proceed with EMM procedures.

entities.name: Timer for enabling E-UTRA
entities.description: An optional timer started when attach or tracking area updating attempt counter reaches 5; on expiry, the UE enables E-UTRA capability under specific mode conditions.

relations.description: Disabling E-UTRA capability is only permitted when the UE is in EMM-IDLE mode.
Receiving reject cause #31 triggers the procedure to disable E-UTRA capability and search for 5GCN-connected cells.
If configured, receiving EMM cause #15 with Extended EMM cause IE value 'E-UTRAN not allowed' triggers E-UTRA capability disabling.
The condition for E-UTRA disabling includes the presence of the Extended EMM cause IE with specific value.
Executing the disable procedure results in the property of E-UTRA capability being disabled, affecting RAT selection and IE settings.
When disabling due to redirection to 5GCN and no suitable cell found, the UE starts an implementation-specific timer.
After starting the timer, the UE enters EMM-REGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE state.
At expiry of the implementation-specific timer, the UE may re-enable E-UTRA capability.
On expiry of the timer for enabling E-UTRA, the UE should enable E-UTRA capability under specific mode conditions.
Re-enabling E-UTRA capability may require the UE to be in EMM-IDLE mode or specific conditions like PLMN selection.
